redFirst.basis: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py plugins/audit/tests/test__runner_collects.py plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py` in a throwaway tree at HEAD: the run timed out after 71 s and its process group was torn down; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: _runner_collects.py: SWEEP_DIRS is now read with ast (a tuple/list of strings or os.path.join of strings; any other expression, an unparsable source, no assignment or an empty tuple is a loud COULD_NOT_TELL naming why, never a partial list). A bare .py basename is resolved against the sweep roots via _output.py_files: found under a root -> COLLECTED; absent from every root but a file at the project root -> NOT_COLLECTED; found nowhere -> COULD_NOT_TELL (a suite the task is about to write, or one living in some other directory, is not a definite no). A path with a directory keeps the prefix judgement, so the P130.38 misroute stops are unchanged. drive-phase.py scope_gap: gate entries entry_collector returns None for are collected as unclassified; when the no-known-runner-takes-this-path branch is reached with any unclassified entry it prints one could-not-tell line and continues (task starts) instead of the scope-gap decision. Tests: 11 cases sb1-sb11 in test__runner_collects.py (118/118), 4 cases uc1-uc4 in test_drive_phase.py (389/389); both suites red on pre-fix code (6 and 2 FAILs seen before implementing). Verified the real tools/sweep-selftests.py reads as its five roots and test_audit_task.py draws COLLECTED. Trade-off for the owner: literal reading of 'any gate entry unclassified' means a gate that also holds lint/validate entries (entry_collector None) answers could-not-tell where it used to stop with 'no runner takes this path'; the other three stops (a known runner's definite NOT_COLLECTED) are untouched. The full sweep was not run by me (own-tests only).
outcome.descriptive: The scope preflight no longer stops falsely on a bare-basename sweep suite or a gate with an entry it cannot classify, and SWEEP_DIRS is read as code.
